description: Toyota Prius (THS-II) power-split hybrid: the planetary set as a bond graph, the engine, MG1, MG2, NiMH battery and vehicle on the NEDC with a rule-based and an ECMS energy management. Numbers from design/design.json and the published references in the README.

checks.note: steady state: T_sun = Zs/(Zs+Zr) T_c = 16.67 N*m = b_s w_s (design.py kinematics)
T_ring = Zr/(Zs+Zr) T_c = 43.33 N*m = b_r w_r
w_c = (Zs w_s + Zr w_r)/(Zs+Zr) (Willis)
carrier power T_c w_c
Willis equation of the planetary set, Zs w_sun + Zr w_ring - (Zs+Zr) w_carrier = 0 at every sample: the flow balance of the bond graph's mesh 0-junction
torque split T_sun : T_ring = Zs : Zr at every instant (the common effort of the mesh 0-junction)
the planetary set is power conserving: P_carrier = P_sun + P_ring
the bond-graph planetary agrees with the stdlib PlanetaryGear (equation block)
the same for the sun
Tellegen over all port powers
no derivative causality, no torn algebraic loop, no solver or unit error

EV launch with 150 N*m of MG2 from 0.5 s: the closed form v = V tanh(t sqrt(F0 k)/m) with F0 = T FD/r - c_rr m g and the reflected ring, MG2, sun and MG1 inertias (m = 1440.0 kg) gives 30 km/h at 6.730 s; a rigid 1-DOF ODE that adds the spin and iron losses (design.py) gives 6.855 s. The model differs by the half-shaft compliance and the 10 ms stator lag: 0.05 s
Willis equation of the planetary set, Zs w_sun + Zr w_ring - (Zs+Zr) w_carrier = 0 at every sample: the flow balance of the bond graph's mesh 0-junction
MG1's speed control holds the engine at rest against the reaction of the launch torque (|w_e| < 5 rad/s, 50 rpm)
with the carrier at rest the sun turns backwards at Zr/Zs = 2.6 times the ring speed
the HCU holds the battery within its 21 kW rating (ORNL Table 2.1) from the MG2 copper-loss estimate; 1 % for the stator and DC-link transients
Tellegen over all port powers
no derivative causality, no torn algebraic loop, no solver or unit error
the driver follows the NEDC within its +-2 km/h speed tolerance (UN ECE R83)
NEDC distance from the cycle definition, 11.013 km (design.py)
Willis equation of the planetary set, Zs w_sun + Zr w_ring - (Zs+Zr) w_carrier = 0 at every sample: the flow balance of the bond graph's mesh 0-junction
charge sustaining: the final SOC within +-3 % of the 60 % start (a +-3 % SOC swing of the 6.5 A*h pack is about 0.16 MJ, 4 g of fuel)
the BMS coulomb count agrees with the battery's own SOC state

rule-based: published 4.3 L/100 km NEDC combined (Toyota, EU type approval of the 2004 Prius, cold start). The model starts hot and has no auxiliaries, so a lower value is expected: the band 3.3-4.7 L/100 km
engine on-time between the bounds of the cycle: at least the 37 s above 101 km/h (MG1 would overspeed with the engine at rest), at most the 900 s the car moves (the engine is off at standstill)
braking energy the driver asks for at the ring, 1.210 MJ from the cycle trace with the same road loads (design.py regen_share); the PI driver's +-2 km/h tracking error: 5 %

regenerative share of the braking energy, 1 - E_friction / E_brake = 0.986 from the cycle trace: the NEDC decelerations are mild (at most 25 kW at the ring, within the battery's charge limit), so the friction brakes only take the stops below the 6.6 km/h fade-out of the regenerative torque
Tellegen over all port powers; the smooth Coulomb spin and rolling losses and the engine drag are modulated effort sources classified as dissipation
